name: What can go wrong with a shower installation?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with a shower installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are leaks, poor waterproofing, bad shower pan slope, and hidden plumbing problems behind the walls. These issues can cause expensive damage later, so it is worth choosing a contractor who explains exactly how the shower will be sealed and drained.
acceptedAnswer.description: Leaks, bad waterproofing, and poor drain slope are the biggest risks. Hidden plumbing issues can also increase cost and delay the job.
